answer: A remote attestation quotes the enclave code before the identity is allowed to act, and the chain groups identities by quoted measurement, so a farm running one image in one fleet collapses into a single counted voter. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. The river is the quoted measurement, the orchard the group it forms, and the knoll the voice that group is worth; the river and the orchard collapse a farm, while only a fresh knoll of hardware escapes the grouping.
